newsitem.title: USA: Culligan acquires UK equipment maker.
newsitem.headline: Culligan acquires UK equipment maker.

text.p: Water purification products maker Culligan Water Technologies Inc said Tuesday that it has acquired Waterside Plc, a UK-based water treatment equipment manufacturer.
Waterside Plc is one of the largest manufacturers of household water softeners in the United Kingdom, with sales of about $4 million, Culligan said.
Culligan said its Italion operation, Culligan Italiana, has acquired an independent Culligan dealership in Milan.
The cmopany also said it acquired an independent Culligan dealer serving Seattle and Yakima, Washington.
Culligan shares were up 1/4 at 45-5/8 Tuesday.
